name: qr_generate
description: Encode text as a QR Code (ISO/IEC 18004, versions 1-40) and return it as SVG, as a text rendering and as the module matrix in rows of 0/1. Numeric, alphanumeric and UTF-8 byte modes (optional ECI), error correction L/M/Q/H, the smallest version that fits or a forced one, Reed-Solomon codewords over GF(256), block interleaving and the mask with the lowest penalty score; details show the codewords, format and version bits and every mask's penalties. Pure standard library.

error.description: Error correction level: about 7, 15, 25 or 30 % recoverable

mode.description: auto: numeric for digits only, alphanumeric for 0-9 A-Z space $%*+-./:, else byte (UTF-8)

version.description: Force a version; default the smallest that fits

mask.description: Force a mask pattern; default the lowest penalty

boost_error.description: Raise the error level while the data still fits the same version

eci.description: Byte mode: declare UTF-8 with ECI 000026

border.description: Quiet zone in modules (SVG and text)

details.description: Also return codewords, blocks, generator polynomial, format and version bits, mask penalties

catalog.source: ISO/IEC 18004:2015 (QR Code bar code symbology specification), checked against the Thonky QR Code Tutorial (thonky.com/qr-code-tutorial) and segno 1.6.6 (github.com/heuer/segno, BSD), written independently; stdlib replacement for segno
